description: Defines a custom exception class SessionStorageNotWritable within the OrangeHRM project, specifically for the installer exception namespace. This class extends the base PHP Exception class and is used to signal issues related to non-writable session storage during installation.

classes.name: SessionStorageNotWritable
classes.description: A custom exception class indicating that session storage is not writable during the installation process.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Inherits constructor from the base Exception class; no additional implementation.
